title: Find the menu that fits the job.
description: Choose an object type or workflow to inspect the actual menu. These buttons switch Blender screenshots; they do not run the addon.
credit: Captured in Old Modifier Menu 3.4 / Blender 5.2. Named custom tools and saved lists are examples.

states.label: Mesh
states.caption: The mesh menu groups native modifiers, supported node assets and your saved lists.

states.label: Curve
states.caption: The list changes for a curve. Saved combinations that do not fit this object are unavailable.

states.label: Grease Pencil
states.caption: Grease Pencil gets its own modifier categories, including drawing, deformation and colour tools.

states.label: Personal shortlist
states.caption: An example personal menu with categories hidden and Favorites, Stacks and custom node shortcuts kept close.

states.label: Search
states.caption: Searching for smooth finds compatible native modifiers and supported node assets.

states.label: Your node tools
states.alt: Old Modifier Menu: Your node tools
states.caption: Four example user-created Geometry Nodes groups. These names are demonstration assets, not included addon presets.

states.label: Helper objects
states.caption: Add a wire cube, wire sphere or empty as a starting point for modifier controls or references.
